question: Do newer public BUB1B CRISPR profiles provide reproducible, target-specific orthogonal evidence, and do everolimus connections survive identity, quality, context and generic-response challenges?
registration: Exploratory follow-up fixed after v19/v23 results, primary-source review and LINCS2020 metadata inspection, before opening either new expression matrix. Not independent prospective validation.
dataset: Broad LINCS2020 public release; 2020 expression matrices and 2022 metadata
source_policy: Anonymous public download, internal research use. Publish original analysis code and derived findings, not source data files or wholesale expression matrices. Source discovery: L2S2/SigCom primary publications and Broad public objects. No account/API key or agreement click.

quality.missing: unknown/fail operational filter; never impute favorable scores
quality.is_hiq: report separately; not the same rule

analysis: Verify source byte lengths and multipart ETags plus SHA256. Join expression rows by Entrez ID to exactly 978 measured landmarks and columns by exact signature IDs. Explain the 1956 matrix columns missing from metadata rather than invent annotations; omit unmatched profiles from analysis. Confirm finite values, matrix orientation and unique IDs. Read old v23 matrices only as public RNAi references.

Inventory BUB1B guide IDs, source batches, original engineered cell names, 96-hour timing, quality and underlying distil_ids. Check shared replicate IDs between new BUB1B profiles and against older releases. Repeated batches of the same guide are reproducibility checks, not independent guide validation. No knockout protein measurement is available.

Genome-wide cross-batch reproducibility: within each of the 19 cells and 96 hours, average exact duplicates for a given guide/batch only after checking metadata; score all guides from each batch against all guides in each other batch over ranked landmarks. Exclude query-reference comparisons sharing any distil_id. Report same-guide rank among candidate guides, correlation, top-1 and top-5-percent rates for every evaluable query, with BUB1B and the fixed mechanism panel identified. Ranks and dependent comparisons are descriptive, not calibrated p-values. Preserve complete benchmark rows, not only BUB1B or successful targets.

Orthogonal RNAi/CRISPR recovery: construct equal-weight target means separately in the five shared parental/engineered cell pairs. For both deposited v23 raw and PRIME, score all RNAi gene means against all new CRISPR gene means. Report both retrieval directions for every overlapping gene and all BUB1B/MTOR results. Repeat with measured BUB1B transcript removed before ranking as a prespecified sensitivity. Parent and Cas9-engineered cells differ; single-guide knockout differs from partial RNAi and from patient alleles; shared platform/lab and source reuse remain limitations.

Drug connections: within each of the 19 cells, score all compound profiles against every CRISPR target mean on 978 landmarks. This exhaustive same-cell matrix supplies each BUB1B connection's specificity rank among all target genes, rather than treating every negative connection as rescue. Retain full matrices locally with hash inventories and complete BUB1B vectors, named-drug and fixed-mechanism-panel findings. Also report positive MTOR/RPTOR connections as separately labelled mechanism checks. No pooling across compound identifiers, times or doses; keep unqualified queries/results visible and flagged.

Audit all everolimus-labelled compound IDs using deposited isomeric SMILES and the frozen v19 identity adjudication. Reference-matching ID remains BRD-K13514097 unless independent chemical evidence supports a change. Report profile QC at each nominal dose and source overlap with v19. Do not call extra profiles independent studies or nominal dose a clinical exposure margin.

For all BUB1B and MTOR named-drug comparisons repeat correlation after removing the measured BUB1B transcript, and after subtracting the cell's mean CRISPR rank vector from query and drug and renormalizing. The latter is an explicitly imperfect generic-response sensitivity, fitted without BUB1B, not a validated confounder correction. Preserve all signs and exact sample counts. No hypothesis-test threshold, drug efficacy probability or automatic promotion is defined.

Validate representative CUDA scores and every BUB1B cross-batch score against float64 CPU SciPy Spearman from extracted original values within 2e-5; independently spotcheck original GCTX coordinates and exact ID joins. Disable TF32; report all attempts, eight worker UUIDs, wall time, timed GPU products, peak allocation and one-second utilization. Computation counts are not biological replicates.
assignment: Sorted cell index modulo eight; separate processes constrained by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Batch large matrix products and keep reference arrays on device. No unrelated process stopped.
decisions: A new CRISPR profile closes the older panel's coverage gap only. A single guide cannot pass the independent-guide requirement regardless of favorable expression scores.

Cross-batch or cross-modality failures require greater model qualification. Favorable reproducibility is retained but cannot resolve off-target effects, loss-versus-adaptation direction, engineered-parent differences or normal-tissue function.

If everolimus resembles BUB1B loss or connection signs change with common-response removal, reject an unconditional expression-reversal rationale. Opposite signs alone do not prove rescue: checkpoint, survival and tissue function must be measured jointly.

Valid lower-nominal-dose or MTOR connections can improve selection of research assay conditions but never set a child's dose or establish a clinical margin. No clinical prescribing or wet-lab execution is part of this campaign.

Retain no rescue-priority drug, optional model-qualified everolimus probe, HCQ reserve, unknown phase/allele function/exposure, and no experiments performed by this project. Update the qualification and decision plan using all results.
data_boundary: Public source data and code only on the owner host under ~/v. No raw subject data, clinical narrative, credentials or model-provider inference.
delivery: New v25 research addendum, complete result tables, archive/inventory, CPU validation and public checker. Preserve frozen presentation v24 and all historical inputs; current harness explicitly points to the new addendum and records presentation integration status.
